Title: SMC CQ2A50-125DCZ cylinder Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: CQ2A50-125DCZ
DESCRIPTION: C(D)Q2, Compact Cylinder, Double Acting Single Rod, Long Stroke w/Auto Switch Mounting Groove
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Magnet: None Mounting: A (Both Ends Tapped) Type: Standard Bore Size: diameter 50 mm Port Thread Type: Rc Stroke: 125 Cushion: C (Rubber Bumper) Body Option: Standard (Rod End Female Thread) Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5 m or None in the Case of No Switch Number: 2 pcs. Rod End Options: None Made of Stainless Steel: None Fluororubber Seal: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: Following a review of our popular CQ2 compact cylinder Series our R&D engineers have totally redesigned the complete cylinder range to bring you even more performance benefits and increased cylinder options. The major difference between the new CQ2 range and the old model is the totally redesigned body, which offers improved auto-switch mounting possibilities plus an overall reduction of cylinder weight of between 5 -13% depending on the model. Now, all CQ2 cylinders from diameter 32 to 200mm are designed with slide in grooves which can accommodate auto-switches on all four cylinder sides without the need for auto-switch brackets. LONG DESCRIPTION: Our updated pilot operated 2 port solenoid valve, VXD Series, is 7% smaller than former conventional models, whilst still delivering big benefits to customers. The renewed VXD Series supports our commitment to developing new innovations to drive energy savings for customers; it's not only more compact, but uses less power. Ideal for air, water, oil, heated water and high temperature oil applications, ranging from car wash centres to oil lines in process industries, the VXD Series is available in a wide range of body materials – aluminium, resin, brass and stainless steel – and offers low concentration ozone resistant and oil free options. Labour savings can also be enjoyed, as the air version with resin body offers a built-in one-touch fitting option. Other features include a rubber buffer that reduces the valve's operating noise levels and thanks to a special construction, its life-span has been extended. It also has an improved OFF response when operated with high viscosity fluids such as oil.

The renewed VXD Series supports our commitment to developing new innovations to drive energy savings for customers; it's not only more compact, but uses less power. Ideal for air, water, oil, heated water and high temperature oil applications, ranging from car wash centres to oil lines in process industries, the VXD Series is available in a wide range of body materials – aluminium, resin, brass and stainless steel – and offers low concentration ozone resistant and oil free options. Other features include a rubber buffer that reduces the valve's operating noise levels and thanks to a special construction, its life-span has been extended. It also has an improved OFF response when operated with high viscosity fluids such as oil.

Ideal for air, water, oil, heated water and high temperature oil applications, ranging from car wash centres to oil lines in process industries, the VXD Series is available in a wide range of body materials – aluminium, resin, brass and stainless steel – and offers low concentration ozone resistant and oil free options. PROPERTIES/VALUES: Size/Valve Type: 3 (10A, N.C.) Body/Port/Orifice: A (C37 / 1/4 / diameter 10) Voltage/Electrical entry: G (24 VDC - DIN terminal with surge voltage suppressor) Special Voltage: None Other Options (Oil-free/Port Thread): A (No / G) Bracket: None Rotation Angle: None

This zero differential pressure type requires no fluid pressure to operate the valve and has minimal air leakage, improving the operational reliability of the VXS Series. With an extended service life, the VXS can perform 3 million cycles and has an improved scraper function that minimises the number of foreign particles entering the valve, improving its resistance to contamination. Consuming less power, this latest edition is environmentally friendly to operate and is quieter thanks to a rubber buffer. Available in either brass or stainless steel, with piping thread variations of 1/4inch to 1inch, a class H solenoid type and an oil free option, the VXS is suitable for a range of applications including sterilisation, heating and pressing processes within various sectors.
BULLET POINTS: No fluid pressure required for the valve operation. Long life service: 3 million cycles. Improved contamination resistance. High sealing – Minimum leakage. Reduced apparent power consumption. Low-noise construction. Piping variations: Threads from 1/4inch to 1inch.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we are proud to unveil our upgraded multi-purpose VXZ series 2 port solenoid valve. Pilot operated, the VXZ has zero differential pressure so it can handle both low pressure fluids and low vacuum and because it doesn't rely on compressed air to operate, it's simple to install. Up to 27% lighter and 4% smaller than conventional models, the VXZ is ideal for lightweight machines and narrow spaces. And a rubber buffer means the series is suitable for quiet environments, with an extended service life guarantee thanks to its improved construction, which is all part of our commitment to refine the performance and functionality of our products and drive competitive advantages for our customers. Available in low concentration ozone resistant and oil free options, the VXZ series comes in a wide range of body materials, with piping thread variations ¼inch to 1inch and one-touch fitting from diameter 10 to diameter 12. Together with normally closed or normally open valve types and an improved OFF response, the VXZ is ideal for handling air, water, oil, heated water and high temperature oil for cooling systems, segmentation of pneumatic lines and exhaust valve in vacuum lines.

Pilot operated, the VXZ has zero differential pressure so it can handle both low pressure fluids and low vacuum and because it doesn't rely on compressed air to operate, it's simple to install. Up to 27% lighter and 4% smaller than conventional models, the VXZ is ideal for lightweight machines and narrow spaces. And a rubber buffer means the series is suitable for quiet environments, with an extended service life guarantee thanks to its improved construction, which is all part of our commitment to refine the performance and functionality of our products and drive competitive advantages for our customers. Available in low concentration ozone resistant and oil free options, the VXZ series comes in a wide range of body materials, with piping thread variations ¼inch to 1inch and one-touch fitting from diameter 10 to diameter 12. Together with normally closed or normally open valve types and an improved OFF response, the VXZ is ideal for handling air, water, oil, heated water and high temperature oil for cooling systems, segmentation of pneumatic lines and exhaust valve in vacuum lines.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we are proud to unveil our upgraded multi-purpose VXZ series 2 port solenoid valve. Pilot operated, the VXZ has zero differential pressure so it can handle both low pressure fluids and low vacuum and because it doesn't rely on compressed air to operate, it's simple to install. Up to 27% lighter and 4% smaller than conventional models, the VXZ is ideal for lightweight machines and narrow spaces. And a rubber buffer means the series is suitable for quiet environments, with an extended service life guarantee thanks to its improved construction, which is all part of our commitment to refine the performance and functionality of our products and drive competitive advantages for our customers. Available in low concentration ozone resistant and oil free options, the VXZ series comes in a wide range of body materials, with piping thread variations ¼inch to 1inch and one-touch fitting from diameter 10 to diameter 12. Together with normally closed or normally open valve types and an improved OFF response, the VXZ is ideal for handling air, water, oil, heated water and high temperature oil for cooling systems, segmentation of pneumatic lines and exhaust valve in vacuum lines.
BULLET POINTS: Body material: Aluminum, Resin, C37, Stainless Steel

Pilot operated, the VXZ has zero differential pressure so it can handle both low pressure fluids and low vacuum and because it doesn't rely on compressed air to operate, it's simple to install. Up to 27% lighter and 4% smaller than conventional models, the VXZ is ideal for lightweight machines and narrow spaces. And a rubber buffer means the series is suitable for quiet environments, with an extended service life guarantee thanks to its improved construction, which is all part of our commitment to refine the performance and functionality of our products and drive competitive advantages for our customers. Available in low concentration ozone resistant and oil free options, the VXZ series comes in a wide range of body materials, with piping thread variations ¼inch to 1inch and one-touch fitting from diameter 10 to diameter 12. Together with normally closed or normally open valve types and an improved OFF response, the VXZ is ideal for handling air, water, oil, heated water and high temperature oil for cooling systems, segmentation of pneumatic lines and exhaust valve in vacuum lines.

Title: SMC CQ2WB63-10DZ COMPACT CYLINDER Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: CQ2WB63-10DZ
DESCRIPTION: C(D)Q2W, Compact Cylinder, Double Acting Double Rod w/Auto Switch Mounting Groove
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Magnet: None Mounting: B (Through Hole [Standard]) Type: Standard Bore Size: diameter 63 mm Port Thread Type: Rc Stroke: 10 Body Option: Standard (Rod End Female Thread) Auto Switch Groove: Z (Auto Switch Mounting Grooves) Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5 m or None in the Case of No Switch Number: 2 pcs. or None in the Case of No Switch Rod End Options: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Made of Stainless Steel: None Fluororubber Seal: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: Following a review of our popular CQ2 compact cylinder Series our R&D engineers have totally redesigned the complete cylinder range to bring you even more performance benefits and increased cylinder options. The major difference between the new CQ2 range and the old model is the totally redesigned body, which offers improved auto-switch mounting possibilities plus an overall reduction of cylinder weight of between 5 -13% depending on the model. Now, all CQ2 cylinders from diameter 32 to 200mm are designed with slide in grooves which can accommodate auto-switches on all four cylinder sides without the need for auto-switch brackets. And, for smaller bore sizes between diameter 12 and 25mm, slide in grooves have also been integrated in the new body design to accommodate bracket free auto-switches on two surfaces. Designed for use with our simple to set, dual colour, solid state auto-switches, the integrated auto-switch channel ensures total protection against potential accidental damage and improved health and safety benefits during both installation and maintenance procedures.
BULLET POINTS: Double acting, double rod, compact cylinder Bore sizes (mm): 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 Standard stroke range (mm): 5 to 100 Port threads: M (12 to 25 bore); Rc, NPT or G (32 to 100 bore) Can mount small auto switches on 4 surfaces.
